newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian central bank sells 300 bln rbls of bills.
newsitem.headline: Russian central bank sells 300 bln rbls of bills.

text.p: The central bank sold 300 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Tuesday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 22059 issue closed on Tuesday at 97.57 percent and the 22060 issue closed at 97.08 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
